units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87:10">Gen. R. s. 87</cite>, end <he>כּוֹפֶפֶת אני את קומתך … כְּפוּפִים</he> (Potiphar’s wife said to Joseph) I shall bend thy proud stature (humiliate thee with slave labor); said he, The Lord erects those who are bowed down.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 55b:19">B. Kam. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>הכּוֹפֵף … בפני וכ׳</he> he who bends his neighbor’s grain stalks before the fire (so as to make them catch fire).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 6">Num. R. s. 6</cite>, beg. <he>נביא כופף ידיו וכ׳</he> the prophet must bend his hands and feet to sit before (surrender his power to) the high priest; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:5:6">Y. Hor. III, 48ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מְכַפֵּת</he>). Cant. R. beg. <he>לָכוֹף אזניך וכ׳</he> to bend thy ear and listen; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>כָּפוּף</he>, f. <he>כְּפוּפָה</he>, pl. <he>כְּפוּפִים</he>, <he>כְּפוּפִין</he>; <cite ref="K00990"><he>כְּפוּפוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 17a:6">Sabb. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>היה הלל כ׳ ויושב וכ׳</he> Hillel sat bent (in submission) before Shammai. Gen. R. l. c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:4">R. Hash. III, 4</cite> <he>בשל זכרים כ׳</he> with bent horns of rams.
Yalk. Ex. 276 דווים וכ׳ suffering and humbled (v. סָגַף, סָחַף); a. fr.—Esp. the curved letters כ, נ, פ, צ, opp. פשוט the straight-lined, the shape of the final letters.
Sabb. 104ᵃ (symbolization of letters) נו״ן כ׳ … נ̇אמן כ׳ וכ׳ Nun bent, Nun straightened, faithful when bent (in distress), faithful when straightened (raised up) &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 103b:14">Ib. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ פשוטין וכ׳</he> that one must not write the curved letters straightened &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:1:13">Y. Snh. I, 18ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מומחה שכ׳ ודן</he> an authorized judge that forced (the law requiring three judges) and judged singly.
Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᶜ ר׳ יצחק כ׳ R. J. forced (the law requiring three judges for ḥălitsah); ib. הא רבן כ׳ it was our teacher who did it.
<cite ref="Ketubot 4b">Keth. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לָכוֹף וכ׳ …</he> no husband dares force his wife (in mourning) to paint &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:11">Num. R. s. 14</cite> (play on <he>כף</he>) <he>זה אברהם שכַּף את יצרו וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>שכפף</he>) that refers to Abraham who conquered his inclinations &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:9">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ</cite> top <he>גרמתני לכוֹפְפָהּ</he> thou didst cause me to upset it (the divine image), v. <cite ref="K01007"><he>כָּפָה</he></cite>; (<cite ref="Moed Katan 15b">M. Kat. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>ובעונותיכם הפכתיה</he>). Y. l. c. <he>מטות כְּפוּפוֹת</he> = <cite ref="K00990"><he>כְּפוּיוֹת</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K01007"><he>כָּפָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>כפפתו אימו</he>, read <he>כפתתו</he>, v. <cite ref="K01061"><he>כָּפַת</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 106a">Sabb. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>הסיט כפוף</he> Ar., ed. <cite ref="K00988"><he>כָּפוּל</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="O00603"><he>סיט</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to bend one’s self upon, to take pains (cmp. כְּפַל).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:17">Cant. R. to I, 17</cite> <he>כפפתי לעקור וכ׳</he> I took pains to destroy the passion for idolatry.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 28">Pesik. R. s. 28</cite> [read:] <he>עד שנִכְפְּפָה קומתם וכ׳</he> so that their statures were bent under their load.
<cite ref="Arakhin 19a:37">Arakh. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>שרביט שאינו נכפף</he> a staff (of gold or silver) which cannot be bent.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5">Num. R. s. 5</cite>, end <he>נִכְפְּפָה היריעה וכ׳</he> the curtain around the Ark was bent aside (prob. to be read <he>נכפלה</he>).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 61a:9">B. Kam. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>בנִכְפֶּפֶת</he> when the fire is diverted from its course through the wind; (oth. opin.: when the fire is subdued (low) and creeping over the plants on the ground), opp. <he>קולחת</he> or <he>קודחת</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:17">Cant. R. to I, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> <he>שתי השערות נִכְפָּפוֹת</he> (not … <he>פים</he>) the two hairs (on the neck) are bent, opp. <he>נזקפות</he>; a. e.
